title: MedHEval: Benchmarking Hallucinations and Mitigation Strategies in Medical Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating hallucination mitigation strategies (e.g., VCD, AVISC, DAMRO) that aim to reduce visual token attention biases and visual priors by testing their performance on close-ended and open-ended medical VQA tasks.

Evaluating hallucination mitigation strategies (e.g., PAI, DoLa) designed to reduce text bias and over-reliance on LLM generation language priors, measuring their impact across visual misinterpretation, knowledge deficiency, and context misalignment hallucination tasks.
